_comment: Unspent Thoughts pipeline configuration. pipeline_enabled=false is the one-click kill switch: the workflow and every script check it first and exit without posting. The edit model must differ from the write model (independent check). Paid OpenRouter fallback funded Oct 2026 (~$1-6/mo at full cadence): edit=gpt-oss-120b, triage=glm-5.3-flash, write=kimi-k3.

paid_options._comment: Inert until you add a paid key or flip a slug into the live 'models' section. To use: 1) add the key to ~/.hermes/.env or repo secrets, 2) set the model slug in 'models', 3) optionally reorder provider_chain / job_chain. Billing is per-token except Cloudflare Workers Paid ($5/mo flat, 10K free neurons/day still included).
upgrade_ladder: 1. Groq pay-per-token (~$1/mo for the whole pipeline) — removes every rate limit
2. Cloudflare Workers Paid ($5/mo flat) — unlocks glm-5.3 / kimi-k2.7 / deepseek-v4 on Workers AI, 10K free neurons/day still included
3. Cloudflare Pro ($20/mo) — not needed; bandwidth is already free
